title: Sameday AI Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Sameday AI Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Off The Clock AI, Avoca, ServiceTitan Voice Agent and Podium Larry as Sameday AI alternatives for calls, booking and job pricing.
intro: Looking for a Sameday AI alternative? Compare Off The Clock AI, Avoca, ServiceTitan Voice Agent and Podium Larry. Off The Clock brings answering, booking and follow-up together with QuoteDone’s owner-priced job quotes.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when you want the operator to handle the price as well as the call. Answering, business questions, booking, transfers and follow-up come together with QuoteDone for supported project quotes and website quoting—not a separate quoting task left for you.
reason: A call can be answered and an appointment arranged while the job price is still waiting on you. Off The Clock addresses that unfinished step without dropping the rest of the operator’s job: answering, booking, transfers and follow-up stay part of the offer.

A Sameday alternative should be compared with the Sameday product you would actually buy. Its current site includes phones, campaigns and coaching alongside AI answering; reducing it to a message-taking service would miss the decision. [[sameday-product]]

The published starting plans are Launch at $449 per month with 500 minutes and Scale at $789 with 1,000 minutes. Those are starting packages, not a personalized invoice or a promise that every feature is included. [[sameday-pricing]]
choices: Answer the call. Price the job. Book it.

Your rates are the starting point, not suggested industry averages. QuoteDone uses the actual details of supported jobs and accounts for selected extras before giving a price. Add the website widget and customers can begin the pricing conversation without calling at all.

Make the coaching and escalation requirements explicit. Ask to see a correction after a poorly classified call, the owner’s view of that correction, and whether the desired reporting is included in the proposal.
Treat the native option as a separate cost and workflow comparison. You are evaluating the incremental answering feature, not pretending your existing ServiceTitan subscription disappears.
This belongs on a different branch of the shortlist. Evaluate what you gain from a consolidated operating system and what you must migrate, rather than comparing the answering feature alone.

scenario.title: The test: change the job after the first answer
scenario.text: Start with a normal inquiry, then add removal or another paid item before accepting the result. Finally, change the preferred appointment. This tests whether the product keeps one coherent request instead of producing a persuasive first response and stale downstream records.
checks: Was the new scope captured and accounted for, rather than silently excluded?
Did the final customer answer reflect the latest request?
Did the owner receive one current record rather than conflicting versions?

questions: Which usage is included: minutes, calls, conversations, locations or users?
Which scheduling actions work with your exact field-service account?
What are the charges and behavior when the allowance is reached?
decision: Choose Off The Clock for the complete incoming inquiry: answer the customer, handle the business questions, quote the supported job, book the appointment and follow up. QuoteDone is the difference on top of the operator—not a substitute for it. Your phone and website can both start with your pricing, while you stay off the clock.
faqs: Is Sameday a flat unlimited subscription?
Its pricing page starts with minute allowances. Do not describe the displayed plans as unlimited calling. [[sameday-pricing]]
Can Sameday connect with Jobber or ServiceTitan?
Both appear in its official integration directory. Verify the actions available to your account rather than assuming every possible workflow. [[sameday-integrations]]
